title: Tamizh Selvan
desc: Tamil Selvan, an honest IAS officer, falls in love with Fathima, a research scholar. Later due to a turn of events, he attracts the ire of Vedimuthu, a corrupt MLA, and his family.

title: Avvai Shanmugi
desc: After losing custody of his daughter by trying to abduct her from her mother, Pandiyan disguises himself as an elderly female caretaker to be close to her.

title: Kaalamellam Kaathiruppen
desc: Kannan, a man from a wealthy family, falls in love with Manimekalai, after hearing her sing in a temple, later he comes up with new ways to woo her.

title: Makkal Aatchi
desc: Sethupathi, a common man, gets lucky when he accidentally finds a large amount of money in a truck. He decides to use the money to enter politics and ends up becoming the chief minister of the state.
